meta.name: mindustry-packloader
meta.author: Anzuno
meta.description:
[accent[]]Bulk import[[]] maps ([stat[]][[]]) and schematics ([stat[]][[]]) directly from ZIP archives or folders on Android and Desktop.

[accent[]]Usage:[[]]
  [accent[]]1.[[]] [stat[]]Main Menu:[[]] [lightgray[]]Click [white[]]"Pack Loader"[[]] to open the loader dialog.[[]]
  [accent[]]2.[[]] [stat[]]Schematics / Maps:[[]] [lightgray[]]Click [white[]]"Import .zip"[[]] or [white[]]"Scan Folder"[[]] directly inside their respective dialogs.[[]]
  [accent[]]3.[[]] [stat[]]Workflow:[[]] [lightgray[]]Select Source -> Review items & Conflict policy -> Tap Import.[[]]

[accent[]]Features:[[]]
  [stat[]] Bulk Import:[[]] [lightgray[]]Import dozens of maps and schematics from .zip packs or folders in one operation.[[]]
  [stat[]] Smart Conflict Handling:[[]] [lightgray[]]Choose how to resolve duplicate files ([white[]]Skip[[]], [white[]]Overwrite[[]], [white[]]Rename[[]]).[[]]
  [stat[]] Instant Hot-Reload:[[]] [lightgray[]]Automatically reloads game maps and schematics immediately without restarting Mindustry.[[]]
  [stat[]] Safe & Validated:[[]] [lightgray[]]Built-in Zip Slip protection, format header validation, and atomic writes.[[]]
  [stat[]] Mobile-Optimized:[[]] [lightgray[]]Touch-friendly UI, search filtering, and System File Picker ([white[]]SAF[[]]) support.[[]]
  [stat[]] Seamless Integration:[[]] [lightgray[]]Quick-access buttons in Main Menu, Schematics, Custom Game, and Map Editor.[[]]
